keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria has no Senones row (the Senones of Gaul at Agedincum are another polity); the page has no infobox area. Rimini, Pesaro e Urbino and Ancona provinces overshoot into the Apennines and the Esino south of Ancona, soft edges. The ager Gallicus becomes Roman in 283 (Ariminum colony 268).

ledger.note: 390 BC: 'In 390 BC, the Senoni Gauls invaded Italy from the north and occupied Picenum north of the Esino river' (Picentes page); the Senones page has them 'settling on the Adriatic coast between Ariminum (modern-day Rimini) and Ancona, displacing the Umbrians' in 'the 4th century BC' (it rejects Livy's c. 600) and the sack of Rome 'around 390 BC'. The strip is drawn once, as the Umbri's land they displaced (umbri /ledger/1), not as Picene (picentes drops its 390 loss).
298-295 BC: the Third Samnite War coalition; 'Rome defeated a coalition of Samnites, Gauls, Etruscans, and Umbrians at Sentinum' (295).
